false_positive_rate.definition: zero-depth trials in test-split chunks (never used for calibration)

notes: All methods are evaluated on the same test chunks and labels.
The physics detector's threshold is calibrated on train-split controls only.
ML preprocessing (scaling, imputation) is fitted on train rows only.

limitations: Independent units are contiguous chunks (3-4 per dataset), not individual cadences.
Injections are coherent across each chunk's transits, at a hidden phase offset from the published ephemeris.
Synthetic injection recovery does not establish real-planet detection performance.
The ML benchmark uses six time-domain features and very few independent groups; treat it as exploratory.

controls.scope: S/N histogram uses all valid zero-depth controls (calibration + test); the false-positive rate uses test-split controls only
